review_candidates.title: Lead Systems Administrator, Virtual Desktop & Infrastructure Services
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Title Lead Systems Administrator, Virtual Desktop & Infrastructure Services At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. The Lead Systems Administrator, Virtual Desktop & Infrastructure Services serves as the senior technical lead for enterprise virtual desktop and infrastructure platforms within the Corporate IT Infrastructure organization. This role is responsible for the administration, optimization, automation, and continuous
eligibility_evidence: Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions.
Lead infrastructure modernization, migration, cloud adoption, and technology refresh initiatives across on premises and hybrid cloud environments.
Strong understanding of enterprise storage, backup, disaster recovery, and hybrid cloud operating models.
Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation and hybrid cloud infrastructure architectures.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Basic Qualifications Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 8+ years of progressive information technology experience with hands-on experience administering enterprise virtual desktop environments utilizing Omnissa Horizon and/or Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting large scale global virtual desktop environments.
